listDocuments.description: Read-only. List every document in the signed-in account via GET /api/v3/client/client_documents. Reuses an open portal tab, else opens a background one and waits out the auth redirect.

pageUrls.description: Read-only. Collect short-lived presigned S3 image URLs for each page of one document (docId) or all documents. The fetch loop runs in the page and stores its result on window.__draPages, then polls. The caller downloads the PNGs.

docId.description: one document id; omit for all documents

listCompanies.description: Read-only. List the account's companies via GET /api/v3/client/companies.

returns.description: the API's companies array (name, id, entity type)
